detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

N-Acetyl Epithalon Amidate

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C14H22N4O9
  • Molecular Weight: ~432.0 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ac-Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly-NH₂
  • Peptide Length: Tetrapeptide
Chemical Modifications:
  • N-terminal acetylation
  • C-terminal amidation
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

N-Acetyl Epithalon Amidate is a chemically modified synthetic tetrapeptide derived from the Epithalon peptide backbone. The compound incorporates N-terminal acetylation and C-terminal amidation, structural modifications commonly applied in peptide chemistry to influence molecular stability and resistance to enzymatic degradation in experimental systems.

Supplied as a lyophilized powder, N-Acetyl Epithalon Amidate is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of short-chain peptide analogs in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and stability analysis of acetylated and amidated tetrapeptides
  • Comparative studies of modified versus non-modified peptide backbones
  • Analytical method development involving low-molecular-weight synthetic peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling procedures at all times
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in common laboratory solvents
Compliance Notice:

N-Acetyl Epithalon Amidate is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
